baseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI API, sent with every request. Resolves provider-first (active provider url, then CLI --ai-url, config aiUrl, env AI_URL/HOTDOG_AI_URL); if nothing resolves it, boot only warns and the first LLM request throws "No AI URL configured".

apiKey.description: API key for the AI endpoint (bearer auth). Resolves provider-first, then CLI -k/--api-key, config apiKey, env HOTDOG_API_KEY/AI_API_KEY; the settings panel treats it as a write-only secret.

thinkerFormat.description: Format string for thinking/reasoning output in the CLI sinks; {} is replaced by the thinking content (default '[Thinking: {}]'). Display only -- hideThinking drops the output entirely.

toolCallDisplayFormat.description: Layout template for tool-call lines in the CLI sinks: first {} is the tool name, second a human-readable args summary, never raw JSON. Unset, tools print their own semantic header; setting the template opts out of those headers.

toolOutputFmt.description: Format string for tool-result display in the CLI sinks; {} is the flattened result text, or -- for edit-family tools attesting success -- a capped ANSI diff block. Default fences the output with ---- lines.

modelWireFormat.description: WireFormat registry name shaping harness wrappers (tool results, file includes, system notices); provider/model wireFormat overrides it. The default xml shape comes from the wire-format-xml extension, and an unregistered name throws at request build -- never a silent fallback.

cliFlag.description: Global default WireFormat registry name for model-facing tool results (e.g. xml)

modelRoleMapping.description: RoleMapping registry name deciding where harness messages ride on the wire (system-first sends them as user role, developer as developer role); provider/model roleMapping overrides it. Both built-ins ship in the role-mapping-default extension; an unregistered name throws at request build.

cliFlag.description: Global default RoleMapping registry name for wire roles (e.g. system-first, developer)

chatTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for chat/API requests (default 600). Long-lived streams are bounded sooner by the streamIdleTimeout watchdog, which is the knob for wedged backends.

healthCheckTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for provider health-check probes -- both the info connectivity checks and the provider-pool sweep (default 5).

providerHealthCheckIntervalSecs.description: Interval in seconds for the provider-pool health sweep (probes /health, or /v1/models when fetchModels is on); a down provider is skipped by placement. 0 removes the timer but keeps failure-driven demotion; recovery happens through a successful probe or any completing task.

streamIdleTimeout.description: Streaming inactivity watchdog in seconds (default 240): a stream yielding no event is aborted and re-issued through the normal retry path, so a wedged local backend fails in minutes rather than at chatTimeout. 0 disables.

sessionId.description: Resumable session ID (CLI --session-id; no config-file layer): the run adopts it and restores the on-disk session log when that ID exists. Default null starts a fresh random session.

compactDebug.description: Dump compaction settings and messages to compaction.out.json in the sessions dir for debugging, including manual /compact runs.

noLog.description: Disable session logging. Env layers: HOTDOG_LOG=false (inverted) and HOTDOG_NO_LOG=true both arm it; default false keeps the JSONL session log that resume, search and review read.

logLevel.description: Minimum level for the diagnostic logger lines on stderr/stdout; env HOTDOG_LOG_LEVEL wins over this config value (default info). Read once at boot by an early peek at the config file (before the logger exists), so edits need a restart and a wrong level can hide the warn naming an out-of-set value; unrelated to noLog, which silences the JSONL session log, not this logger.

logTarget.description: Destination for the diagnostic logger: stderr, stdout, or none (silence from the first boot line); env HOTDOG_LOG_TARGET wins over this config value (default stderr). Applied at boot by the same early peek as logLevel (restart to change); 'none' also swallows the warn these keys emit when carrying an out-of-set value; unrelated to noLog, which kills the JSONL session log, not this logger.

reindex.description: Force a full-scan repair of the session index on startup instead of the normal stat-only reconcile; use when the index is suspected to drift from the session logs.

cliFlag.description: Repair the session index on startup: full re-scan of every session log (the index normally rebuilds itself stat-only)

showTokenUse.description: Display token usage stats at the end of responses (default on). With a modelPricing entry for the session model, /tokens appends a cost line.

hideTools.description: Hide tool calls and results from CLI output (default shows them); /tools toggles it mid-session.

cliFlag.description: Show tool calls (now the default; kept for explicit override)

hideThinking.description: Hide thinking/reasoning output from the CLI sinks (default shows it, shaped by thinkerFormat).

useColors.description: Master switch for colored CLI output: layers are CLI --colors/--no-colors, then the config colors entry (which doubles as palette overrides). NO_COLOR or TERM=dumb disables color regardless of this setting.

theme.description: CLI color theme: dark, light, monochrome, or a path to a JSON palette-override file merged over dark. An unreadable or invalid theme file falls back to dark.

cliFlag.description: Theme (dark, light, monochrome, or file path)

defaultModel.description: Default model as provider/model. Resolution chain: CLI --model, profile model, env HOTDOG_MODEL/AI_MODEL, config defaultModel; nothing resolved means agent creation fails with a no-model-configured error (model-free subcommands keep working).

maxIterations.description: Hard cap on agent loop iterations per run (default 1000) -- the runaway-loop safety net; reaching it ends the run.

maxToolCallsPerIteration.description: Tool calls allowed per LLM turn (default 10); calls beyond the cap answer with a skipped-due-to-limit error instead of executing. 0 exposes no tools.

cliFlag.description: Maximum tool calls allowed per LLM turn

contextLimit.description: Fallback context window in tokens for models without a provider/model contextLimit override, and the compaction budget base (compaction.contextLimit can override). Bound at 1 because 0 poisons compaction math; lower it for small-context local models.

maxRetries.description: Retries after the initial attempt (total attempts = 1 + this) for both LLM request errors and transient tool failures; 0 disables retrying. Resolved at boot, so an edit lands on the next start.

toolRetryDelay.description: Backoff base in seconds for retrying tools that throw a TransientError (delay = 2^(attempt-1) * this); 0 retries without waiting. Resolved at boot, so an edit lands on the next start.

maxEmptyRetries.description: Times the loop re-issues a request when a completion carries neither text nor tool calls (a common local-model stall) before ending the run with the empty_response stop reason; 0 disables re-invoke.

maxToolResultChars.description: Central char cap on every finalized tool result (UTF-16 units), applied at the executor seam after the tool:result hook replacement and before the session log / context see it. Each text field over the cap keeps a codepoint-safe prefix plus a '--- [output truncated, N chars elided] ---' marker. Ceiling pinned below the tool-exec wire frame bound (MAX_FRAME_BYTES = 4000000) so a maxed knob can never trip the frame-overflow path; 0 disables the cap.

sandboxMode.description: Restrict the agent to side-effect-free tools (sideEffects metadata filter; untagged tools are excluded too) and skip MCP server connections. For read-only exploration or untrusted models; it is a tool-surface posture, not an OS boundary.

cliFlag.description: Sandbox mode: only allow tools without side effects

toolExec.description: Execution plane for tools tagged execution:worker -- worker runs them in pooled out-of-process executors (crash isolation, cancellation, optional fence), inline runs everything in-process, the pre-plane path. Untagged tools stay inline either way; the plane never silently downgrades.

cliFlag.description: Tool execution plane: worker (tagged tools run in pooled out-of-process executors) or inline (everything in-process, zero added machinery)

execFence.description: Fence for pooled executor entries: probe jails them when the platform backend exists (bubblewrap on Linux, seatbelt on macOS) to the session workspace roots plus a scratch dir; off spawns plain. A failed probe spawns plain and the posture line says so; /fence toggles at runtime per session.

cliFlag.description: Fence for pooled executors: probe (jail when the platform supports it) or off (plain spawn)

envScrubbing.description: When true (default), agent-spawned subprocesses (bash tool, MCP stdio servers, pooled executors) inherit a copy of the environment with secret-shaped variable names stripped -- a heuristic, not a boundary. Set "envScrubbing": false in the config file to turn it off (the flagless spelling of the same opt-out); --disable-env-scrubbing overrides the file and passes the full environment, hotdog's own API keys included. The cli layer reads the INVERTED parse key (disableEnvScrubbing, falsy cast), the config layer reads this key's own plain boolean -- nothing re-inverts the file entry.

cliFlag.description: Pass the full environment to subprocesses (bash tool, MCP stdio) without secret scrubbing (overrides config envScrubbing)

maxToolDifficulty.description: Hard cap on the difficulty (1-5) of tools exposed to the model; sits above the per-model registry entry and defaultMaxToolDifficulty in the priority chain; null = no filtering. Declared layer is CLI-only (--max-tool-difficulty).

cliFlag.description: Maximum tool difficulty (1-5). Overrides model and config defaults.

defaultMaxToolDifficulty.description: Config default maximum tool difficulty (1-5) applied to all models; lowest in the priority chain (CLI --max-tool-difficulty beats a model entry, which beats this). null = no filtering.

taskProfile.description: Profile applied to spawned task agents (subagents), default task-default; top-level sessions use profileName instead. Resolved at boot, so an edit lands on the next start.

taskLanesPerProvider.description: Concurrent turns per provider lane -- both subagent turns and top-level session turns; excess work queues instead of thrashing provider caches. Below 1 means unlimited. A provider's own taskLanes overrides it per machine.

modelGroups.description: Named pools of interchangeable models for delegated placement (referenced as group:<name> from delegate_task, workflow nodes or a profile group): a task takes the first member with a free lane, preferring a warm provider, and queues when all are busy.

modelPricing.description: Opt-in per-model USD per-million-token rates (input, cachedInput, output) that make /tokens print a cost line; computed from the token tracker at display time, never written to the session log. Keys must match the session model name exactly; no entry means no cost guess.

taskLanesDir.description: Directory holding the cross-process lane slot ledger (default <dataDir>/task-lanes). Slot files are heartbeat leases swept hourly -- safe to delete when nothing runs, and must never be synced or snapshotted.

taskSpawnsPath.description: Append-only JSONL sidecar of delegate_task spawn/end records (default <dataDir>/task-spawns.jsonl) so a later process reports never-ended tasks as interrupted by restart; surfacing only, nothing auto-respawns. Workflow spawns live in the run journal instead.

coreTools.description: Config namespace of the core-tools extension (readToolLimit, maxImageSize, findMaxResults, grepMaxResults, maxEditInputSize, ...); the nested fields are documented in docs/config-reference.md.

compaction.description: Config namespace of the compaction extension (strategy, reserveTokens, contextLimit, keepRecentMessages and friends); the nested fields are documented in docs/config-reference.md.

workspace.description: Workspace posture: the roots that bound the file tools and @file expansion, plus the denylist. An empty object means the process CWD is the only root; root and deny semantics are documented in docs/config-reference.md.

deny.description: Denylist globs the file tools must not touch, enforced by resolveSafe inside every root: slash-separated component globs at any depth, last match wins, ! negates (default covers .ssh, .git, .env* etc. with .env.example carved back out). An empty array disables the denylist; bash is not mediated by it.

uploadLimits.description: Size ceilings for user-supplied content (webui uploads, @refs). Core posture: resolved regardless of which extensions are enabled. Legacy fileAttachment.maxFileSize/maxImageSize/maxFiles act as an alias layer (uploadLimits wins).

maxFileSize.description: Per-file byte ceiling for non-image uploads and @file references (default 102400 = 100 KiB), checked after base64 decode. Legacy fileAttachment.maxFileSize is the fallback alias layer.

maxImageSize.description: Per-file byte ceiling for images (default 10485760 = 10 MiB). The websocket transport frame bound derives from it, and legacy fileAttachment.maxImageSize is the fallback alias layer.

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files per message/input (default 10). Legacy fileAttachment.maxFiles is the fallback alias layer.

hookTrace.description: Trace hook execution into the debug log; nothing is emitted unless the log level is debug (env HOTDOG_LOG_LEVEL or config logLevel).

cliFlag.description: Trace hook execution (requires debug level: HOTDOG_LOG_LEVEL or config logLevel)

profileName.description: Active profile name (CLI --profile > config profile key): picks which profiles entry and/or .profile.md file shapes the session (model, tool allow/deny lists, manager mode).

profilesPath.description: Directory scanned for .profile.md files: CLI --profiles-path, config profilesPath, else computed as <configDir>/profiles.

provider.description: Provider selected at boot (CLI --provider > config defaultProvider key): its url and apiKey supply the provider layer of baseUrl and apiKey. An unknown name resolves to no provider with no startup complaint.

systemPromptTemplate.description: Path to a custom system prompt template file; unset auto-detects system_prompt.md inside the config directory.

profiles.description: In-config profile definitions keyed by name, merged with same-named .profile.md files: file profiles win on whitelistTools, blacklistTools and manager; config wins on model and group.

extensionPaths.description: Directories scanned for extensions: @extensions is the built-in set, @experimental the opt-in bundles, anything else a custom path. The value REPLACES the default, so list both aliases to keep the builtins while adding experimental.

extensionAutoload.description: When true (default), every discovered extension that does not mark autoload false is loaded (plus dependencies); when false only the extensions list is loaded -- false with an empty list loads nothing.

extensions.description: Explicit extension selection consulted when extensionAutoload is false: only these names plus their dependencies load. Ignored while autoload is on.

defaultSubcommand.description: Subcommand run when the CLI invocation names none (resolved through the cli-subcommand registry; default cli).

defaultProvider.description: Default provider name when --provider is absent; its url and apiKey supply the provider layer of baseUrl/apiKey. Read through the provider key config layer (same file key) -- this schema entry adds nothing on top of that.

sttUrl.description: Full URL of an OpenAI-compatible audio transcriptions endpoint for speech-to-text. Unset, the backend auto-picks the first registry model declaring audio input and takes endpoint and key from its provider; credentials riding the URL are moved to a Basic auth header.

cliFlag.description: OpenAI-compatible audio transcriptions endpoint (overrides audio-capable model auto-detection)

sttModel.description: Model name sent to sttUrl in the multipart request; without an explicit sttUrl it pins the registry model used for speech-to-text (must declare audio input). Unset = auto-pick.

cliFlag.description: Model name sent to the STT endpoint; pins the registry model used for speech-to-text
